title: Bobbi P NDE 716
content:
I was in the hospital for three days before I came to realize that I was there. My family told me of things that had happened. My first memory of something different was no color, only gray. I saw a video of my life as if someone had videotaped it. I viewed it and saw many people, places and things from my life starting with things that I knew had happened. It was wonderful. The video was in black and white but other than the video, everything was still gray. I wanted to see color again and when I did, it was fantastic! I saw colors I could never explain. A shade of red that I will never forget. Then visions of things that were so real. The visions of things and people that I could examine. It was so wonderful where I was, I wanted to stay, but knew I had to return. I have a son who is thirty-six years old and who was born with cerebral palsy and lives with me. We have a strong bond in life. The family said I was so happy and smiled a great deal. I spent nine days in the hospital and the only long-term effect that is still with me is a blind spot in my right eyesight. This blind spot is hard to describe because there is a nothingness. When I meet other people that have had a stroke, I ask them about their experiences and none has been like mine. I don't know where I was but I do know that it was a place like my dear beloved father had told me about when I was a child. SUCH WONDERMENT!!! Thank you.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Heart attack heart attack and stroke brought on by blood clots that shoot through my body. Life threatening event, but not clinical death I was told that I was not expected to walk of the hospital and that I astounded everyone.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Very alert. I wanted to see everything.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: Music and sounds of all kinds. I thought I could hear flowers grow and giggle.
elements.The experience included: Void | Darkness | Light | A landscape or city | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Boundary
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm See my above answer.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe Mostly I was observing things.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control See my above answer.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I knew I was needed here.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes Don't worry about the little things.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes Nothingness - I would try and tell what was there but I could not explain nothingness. Colors that I never saw before, shapes, flora, beautiful objects and a wonderful feeling of contentment.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The feeling that I experienced along with the beauty I saw.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes My friends and family know that I am a truthful person in what I tell them, they respect it.
